meta.title: Vendor Blocking and Inactive Lifecycle: refused for a user without the Procurement Manager role
gaps: Verify or switch the tenant to the Enterprise plan.
Sign in as a user without the Procurement Manager role and test Vendor Blocking and Inactive Lifecycle, including blocking vendors and reactivating SAP-inactivated vendors.
Repeat the same actions as a Procurement Manager and compare whether the action is refused, absent, or available, including tenant RBAC configuration.
